feature_contract.goal: Preserve the original 6th/6 rank HUD's fixed-function animation and clip digits on one physical D3D9 FVF142 GPU source across left and right XR eye submissions, even if the original native LEFT callback reenters.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only original fixed-function FVF142 DispRank first and eight clip siblings; exclude projected car markers, GOAL, +TIME, lens, F11, SkyGlow, generic sprites, DX11/DXVK and original FFB/input.
trace_stages: Original game 0x004B9D80 DispRank emits first animation at 0xB9DA6 followed by eight kind-0 clips at 0xB9F3A..0xBA052.
Exact game hook tags DispRankFirst and DispRankClipSprite through real SpriteNode queue; R30 original fixed-function FVF142 chooses separate eye projection.
Before LEFT and after the game callback, R30 checks queue node/epoch, producer, shader absence, FVF, pose and GPU draw serial before submitting RIGHT.
subcomponents: Capture exact original fixed-function SpriteNode plus pose, FVF and draw serial at native left GPU boundary and reject inapplicable sources before GPU writes.
Reject a changed producer or queue node after native LEFT without replaying LEFT; preserve projection restoration and mono fail-safe for an invalid RIGHT.
Add portable positive and negative source-mutation regressions for queued/direct kind-1 and clipped siblings, foreign world, FVF and stage.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Original queued or direct exact rank animation and clip number retain their physical command identity across both eyes.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Projected car rank, HUD and mono fallback safety
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Foreign GPU producer, new queue node, changed epoch, FVF, pose or shader cannot borrow 6th/6 right eye or defeat projection restore.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Windows x86 game, host, package and cross-domain checks
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Final integrated source SHA passes DX9Ex Active full chain, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact independently of runtime acceptance.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Original game's Ghidra/static resource map in docs/automation/OUTRUN_VR_REA_RESOURCE_EVIDENCE_20261018.md confirms the 0x004B9D80 fixed 6th/6 UI versus unrelated moving vehicle 0x004BAD20 marker.
source_trace: hooks_uiscaling.cpp tags 0xB9DA6 kind-1 first SpriteNode as DispRankFirst and eight later original clip sites as DispRankClipSprite.
R30TryFixedFunctionOriginalSpriteStereo accepts exact ScreenHud with original FVF142, restores game projection, and calls R30ExecuteXyzrhwStereo.
R30ExecuteXyzrhwStereo already fenced projected car marker, +TIME and GOAL across LEFT, but lacked the equivalent fixed 6th/6 screen command fence.
diagnosis.root_cause: Nested native original-game left Draw could reenter a different fixed-function SpriteNode or producer after preparing eye projection, causing a mismatched right-eye GPU command.
alternatives_rejected: Car Calc3D2D world-rank marker is a different source and cannot classify fixed 6th/6 ScreenHud.
Do not promote all FVF142, effect or unknown sprites or claim HMD visual PASS from a static gate.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Added FixedFnRankHudStamp to mod game header and R30 before/after native-left GPU source validation for original DispRank producers only; unchanged game projection restore, depth error reporting and device fallback.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Extended rank_marker_physical_source_smoke.cpp with positive queued/direct 6th/6 and negative queue, producer, pose, serial, FVF, shader, world and stage mutations; exact build pending.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Both eyes must use one exact game 6th/6 SpriteNode command and one pose; changed after LEFT vetoes RIGHT without resubmitting LEFT.

first_attempt.reason: Exact-head feature record missing; policy gate blocked builds.
